why: Issue #713. The Versus Setup pane resolves devices without the unreadable-pad verdict, so its device column names a pad the Controllers pane marks not supported, and Start stays enabled for a slot that would be bound to it. Seeding (loop.ts) skips that pad, so what the pane displayed would not be what launched -- the divergence issue #260 exists to prevent.
killedBy: hud: versus setup pane (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-21-versus-setup-menu-design.md) skips a pad Tanks cannot read in the device column and the Start gate (issue #713)
